answer: Tie admission to a burn-backed reputation escrow. Each new agent locks a stake that scales with the jobs it wants, like a timber frame holding a structure up: strong joints before any weight goes on. Peers rate finished work, and those ratings compound into reputation the agent borrows against for bigger contracts. If it is caught running duplicate identities, the whole escrow is slashed and burned, so a farmer funding a thousand clones loses a thousand bonds at once. The vine of reputation grows only where real work was paid for, and a fake account is just an echo that returns nothing.
